text:
louise: customer reported sudden 403s for embeddings after SSO rotation — they say the token shows embeddings in the UI but calls to /v1/embeddings return 403. escalation ticket 98765 opened.
ellen: can we get a raw token dump + sample failing request? customer is on our enterprise SSO path (idp-provisioner-v2). they say generation still works but embeddings/rerank fail intermittently.
zach: uploading an auth-service trace now. initial hunch: provisioning pipeline might be inserting a non-printable delimiter when concatenating scopes from SCIM CSV. looking for NULs or weird bytes.
maya: repro steps I ran from a scratch tenant (internal repro):
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciO..." \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/embeddings
# response: {"error":{"code":403,"message":"missing scope: embeddings"}}
```
maya: dumped the token payload and printed as hex — found this in the scope claim (visible here as escaped):
```
"scope":"inference\x00embeddings\x00rerank"
```
zach: yep that matches the auth-service parser bug. our scope splitter expects ascii whitespace or comma, but the provisioner wrote NUL-separated scopes. the downstream JWT library truncates at the first NUL when converting to C-string in one codepath, so only `inference` got recognized and `embeddings`/`rerank` appear missing.
louise: omg — explains why generation worked (inference present) but embeddings/rerank denied. customer impact = high (embedding pipelines broken), started immediately after their SSO rotation.
ellen: recorded steps to reproduce + attached trace to ticket 98765. Priority P1 for CS escalation until workaround in place.
zach: short-term workaround: instruct customer to re-provision via our CLI which normalizes scopes (replaces NULs with spaces) OR to use an org service key with explicit scopes as a temp bypass. sending a sample CLI command:
```
redwood provision --tenant <TENANT_ID> --scopes "inference embeddings rerank" --out svckey.json
```
zach: long-term fix: patch the provisioner to strip control chars and normalize delimiters; also harden auth-service tokenizer to treat NULs as separators, not terminators. i raised a PR #1229 on the auth repo.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: auth-provisioner fix will land on canary in 10m, full roll in 45m (PR: auth/1229). automated canary smoke tests include token-scope normalization now.
maya: validated local canary: provisioner now writes scope claim as "inference embeddings rerank" — embeddings call returns 200 and vector count OK. customer confirmed in the ticket after we asked them to repro with the CLI fallback.
louise: forwarded the workaround to the customer and updated them that engineering is deploying a fix. asked for their internal rotation window — they agreed to retry in 1h.
ellen: updating ticket 98765 with root cause, patch link, workaround, and assign to zach for postmortem. note: add a monitor for NUL/control chars in scope claims for future rotations.
zach: postmortem notes I plan to include: (1) SCIM-to-provisioner CSV join used binary concat that didn't filter whitespace/control bytes, (2) auth tokenizer used libc string funcs in one path, causing silent truncation, (3) lack of unit tests for non-printable delimiters. will add tests + alerting.
louise: customer reply: "thanks, workaround worked. please let us know when fix is live — embeddings are business-critical." :thumbsup:
maya: will keep monitoring ticket until full rollout completes and will mark resolved after one successful tenant rotation without NULs.
ellen: closing loop here — saved logs and traces to ticket 98765 (IDs: trace-5a3f, req-21fc).
